elements.element: Customer may assign to an affiliate without consent.
elements.evidence: The consent-free exception applies only to assignment to a successor in specified transactions; it does not authorize assignment to an Affiliate. Defining Customer to include Affiliates does not create an assignment right.

elements.element: Customer may assign to a successor in a merger, acquisition, or sale of substantially all assets without consent.
elements.evidence: Either party may assign without consent to a successor in connection with a merger, corporate reorganization, or sale of all or substantially all assets, stock, or securities.

elements.element: Vendor may not assign without Customer's consent.
elements.evidence: M&I may assign without Customer's consent to a successor in connection with the specified transactions.

elements.element: Customer's consent to Vendor assignment is not to be unreasonably withheld.
elements.evidence: Where consent is required, the clause states that the other party's prior written consent shall not be unreasonably withheld.

elements.element: Vendor may never assign to a Customer competitor.
elements.evidence: The clause contains no prohibition on assignment to a Customer competitor.

elements.element: Customer's change of control gives Vendor no termination right.
elements.evidence: The rendered language requires M&I to continue providing Services following Customer's Change in Control, subject to stated scope and volume limits, and grants no termination right.

elements.element: Both parties may assign to a successor.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly permits either party to assign to a successor in connection with the specified transactions.

elements.element: A successor assignment requires written notice.
elements.evidence: A consent-free successor assignment is expressly conditioned on written notice to the other party.
Assignments outside the successor exception require the other party's prior written consent.

elements.element: Consent to other assignments is not to be unreasonably withheld.
elements.evidence: The required consent expressly shall not be unreasonably withheld.
